formula: Each limit is the limit of the old measure until 5 runs are read. Then each limit is the worst plus the spread over the runs of the smallest limit that passes that case alone, from gate-margin.ts, with 5 or more runs of 2 jobs of 24 rounds, so that each run shows both looks. The slowdowns are one more command in a read or a write, stated before the runs. A case with no slowdown it can hold is report only, and a case whose flip reads no read is report only.
